title: Eng org sync — open floor notes (Apr 2026)
content:
Attendees: ~85 engineers + PMs across infra, runtime, SRE, product.
Host: Priya Shah (eng ops)
Date: 2026-04-08 10:00 PT
Duration: 55m (ran slightly over)
Location: All-hands -> #eng-org, recording on drive (link above)

Goal: quick status pulses from subteams, surface risks, open floor Q&A and capture follow-ups. Keep notes rough — this is the working doc.

Agenda (timeboxed):
- 10m: Quick metrics snapshot (SLOs + cost)
- 20m: Lightning updates (serving-runtime, platform, private, optimize, console)
- 15m: Open floor / questions (pre-submitted + live)
- 10m: Action items / next steps / parking lot

---
Metrics snapshot (Aisha) — 10m
- Latency: cluster p50 stable at 18ms, p95 moved from 320ms -> 295ms week-over-week after kernel dropout fix (small wins). Observed tail improvement mainly on sequence-length >1024 workloads.
- Errors: 0.8% transient errors on hosted API (mostly 503s during region failover). SRE working hypothesis: misrouted cached KV invalidation + race in fallback router.
- Cost: token throughput improved via batching heuristics; unit cost down ~6% QoQ for busiest customers. Intelligent batching pilot across two Dedicated fleets next week.
- Capacity: Dedicated headroom ~18% reserved in us-west1 for upcoming enterprise rollouts.
Notes: Request teams to surface any regressions in evals channel — especially for quality vs quantization experiments.

Lightning updates — 20m
- Serving Runtime (Connor)
  - Rolled out optimized attention kernels for causal-16k models; early customers report 12–18% reduction in GPU time on long-context chat.
  - Known issue: intermittent OOMs for small-batch long-history requests; workaround: temp per-model max-kv-size cap. Long-term fix tracked in PR #892 (link above).
  - Roadmap item: memory-mapped KV caching prototype ready for internal dogfooding in May.
  - Ask: Need two volunteers from platform-engineering to help perf-test mmKV on 8xA100 nodes next Tue.

- Platform Engineering (Miguel)
  - Autoscaler tuning: added jitter to scale-down path — reduced noisy retry storms during scale-down windows.
  - Dedicated offering: pricing proposal revised; will share with product for review by EOD Friday.
  - Infra migrations: testing new node images that include latest NCCL and cuDNN for perf gains; expect rollout to stage in 2 weeks.

- Private Deployments (Sofia)
  - First on-prem customer onboarding started: checklist refined (KMS, audit logs, network templates).
  - Docs: private-deploy quickstart updated with explicit firewall rules — please review and comment.
  - Risk: air-gapped installs still need an approved image delivery flow; Security is blocking until SCA scans pass.

- Console & Rollouts (Aisha)
  - Rollouts: Canary API now supports weighted traffic split by customer tag — helps A/B rollouts without infra changes.
  - Observability: token-level breakdown added to per-route dashboard; users can now filter by model family.
  - UX note: feedback that canary rollout latency histogram UI is confusing — design follow-up scheduled.

- Optimize (Priya)
  - Cost toolkit: preliminary recommendations engine prototype that suggests quantization + batch-size combos for a workload. Early evals show 10–20% cost reduction with minimal quality loss for retrieval-heavy workloads.
  - Next steps: integrate recommendations into Console suggestions panel (P0-ish). Need Product + UX sync.

Open floor highlights / Q&A — 15m
- Q: What is the expected timeline for the mmKV prototype to hit Dedicated? (from #infra)
  - A (Connor): internal dogfood in May, public beta mid-June. Need platform test volunteers.

- Q: Any SLAs on Private deployments? (from Sales)
  - A (Sofia): SLA template exists but needs legal sign-off for on-prem. Target: include base availability SLA in Q3 contracts.

- Q: Can we get a short doc on best practices for batching + prefix caching for partner teams? (from Solutions Eng)
  - A: Yes — Optimize team will draft a 1-pager and post to docs repo by Apr 22.

- Live feedback: Several folks called out noise in alerts from canary deploys; SRE will triage and tune thresholds.

Raised concerns / red flags
- Incident drift: Multiple teams called out that post-incident writeups are missing follow-ups — action: SRE to enforce runbook remediation checklist (see action items).
- Model quality regressions: one internal eval flagged hallucination drift after quantization on small LLM. Research and Optimize need to coordinate on guardrail tests.

Action items (owner — due)
- SRE: enforce incident remediation checklist; add explicit "owner+ETA" field to all postmortems (Connor) — due 2026-04-15.
- Serving Runtime: add mmKV perf test invite to platform-engineering; specify test cases and dataset (Connor + Miguel) — due 2026-04-14.
- Optimize: publish 1-pager best-practices for batching/prefix caching (Priya + Aisha) — due 2026-04-22.
- Private Deployments: unblock air-gapped image delivery by getting SCA scan schedule from Security (Sofia + Security) — due 2026-04-20.
- Console: clarify canary latency histogram UX + prototype wireframes (Aisha + Design) — due 2026-04-18.
- Platform Eng: review Dedicated pricing doc and provide feedback to Product (Miguel) — due 2026-04-10 (urgent).

Parking lot / non-blocking items
- Consider POC for cross-region KV replication for ultra-low tail latency — tech debt item, add to Q3 roadmap discussion.
- Revisit token-level billing UX for large customers — Finance/product to sync separately.

Notes to self / org housekeeping (informal)
- Reminder: next all-hands slot May 6; consider making it a "deep-dive" on quantization effects and evaluation harness.
- Collect short 1-min updates from subteam leads before next sync to keep meeting to 45m.
- We should publish a short TL;DR email for GTM afterwards with 3 bullets: metrics wins, top risk, 3 action items assigned.

Follow-ups & links
- Recording + slide deck: CONFLUENCE-ENG-ORG-2026-04 (linked above).
- Runtime PR for OOM fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/892
- Incident writeup template: JIRA-ENG-2345

Unresolved questions (capture for next week)
- How to measure real-world quality impact of quantization on customer-facing chat — need standardized eval dataset and user-simulated prompts.
- Should Dedicated customers be able to self-serve minor model swaps within a pinned version? (policy question for product/legal)

End notes
- Overall tone: many small wins on perf and cost, a few medium-priority operational risks. Strong cross-team collaboration on next steps.

If you were at the meeting and have additional notes, please append below (unstructured).
